game.title: Sniper Elite 3
game.blurb: Stealth sniping shooter set in North Africa in World War II, from Rebellion (RAWG also lists 505 Games), published by 505 Games and Rebellion, released 2014-06-26. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure. Chapters follow the campaign missions named in the Steam achievements.

chapters.title: Missions 1 to 4
chapters.summary: The first four campaign missions, including the mountain pass, the wells in Gaberoun, the visiting General and reaching the informant unseen.

chapters.title: Missions 5 to 8
chapters.summary: The last four campaign missions, including the officer's "accident", Kasserine Pass, the bomb dumps and the bridges. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Collectibles and 100%
chapters.summary: War diaries, collectible cards, sniper nests, long shots, optional objectives and 100% of the campaign.

chapters.title: Difficulty
chapters.summary: Finishing the game on Cadet, Marksman, Sniper Elite and Authentic difficulty.

chapters.title: Co-op, Challenges and Multiplayer
chapters.summary: The co-op campaign, the challenge missions, competitive multiplayer matches and ribbons, and trying every mode.

chapters.title: Added Missions
chapters.summary: The extra missions the achievements name: In Shadows, Belly of the beast and Confrontation.

chapters.title: Target, Tower and Shooting Range
chapters.summary: The extra target mission with its many ways to kill, the far tower and AA gun feats, and the Shooting Range.

chapters.title: Sniping and Combat
chapters.summary: Relocating, tagging, explosives and chain reactions, flint distractions, long-distance sniping, holding your breath, rank levels, loadouts and rifle customising.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 238090)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Sniper_Elite_III
Fandom (sniperelite.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://sniperelite.fandom.com/wiki/Sniper_Elite_III
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3651). Steam app 238090 ("Sniper Elite 3") was used. StrategyWiki redirects "Sniper Elite 3" to "Sniper Elite III", a stub (completion stage 0, marked as a perfect stub): Gameplay, Walkthrough and Table of Contents are linked but not written. sniperelite.fandom.com redirects "Sniper Elite 3" to "Sniper Elite III", with about 107 linked articles (including place names such as Gaberoun, Halfaya Pass, Fort Rifugio, Siwa Oasis and Kasserine Pass, and "Hunt the Grey Wolf", "In Shadows", "Belly of the Beast" and "Confrontation"); names only were looked at, nothing copied, and the mission order is not in the Fandom data, so missions are grouped by number. None of the 77 Steam achievements is hidden. The added content is split by API name: DLC02 to DLC04 name their missions ("In Shadows", "Belly of the beast", "Confrontation"); DLC01 (a target mission, 10 achievements), OW03 (a tower and AA guns, 4) and DLC05 (Shooting Range, 2) do not name their mission, so they share a chapter. "Elite fan" (owning the earlier games) sits in the combat chapter by default.
